claims.statement: For Q=h(X)+F(Z)+G(Y)+2X ell(Z)+2 U^T S V with X an original scalar independent of product banks Z,Y, U,V two-dimensional projections, ell any same-Z-bank scalar linear form, and S invertible, ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3(L_X M_U M_ell M_V/|det S|)^(1/3), and the density is continuous C0.

In the r42 unique-heavy exact-rank-three collar, if the unique heavy spectral direction is exactly the left null direction of the rank-two H-to-T crossing, then ||p_Q||_infinity < 270.176/s with a continuous C0 density.
Using account02/B11 QFORM-3D-PROJECTION-CROSS-L2-v1, sigma1 sigma2 > kappa_* s^2 and |sigma3| >= beta0 s/8 imply ||p_Q||_infinity < 447.393/s continuously.
